title: Configure the Matrix-Discord voice bridge
description: Configure the bridge from a Matrix 1:1 call to a Discord voice channel. Omitted fields keep their current value; omitted or empty tokens keep the current token. After the request all required settings must be set.

matrix_homeserver_url.description: Client-server API URL of the bot's homeserver, like https://matrix.example.org

matrix_access_token.description: Access token of the bot's Matrix account; empty keeps the current token

matrix_allowed_user.description: The only Matrix user whose calls are accepted, like @me:example.org

matrix_room_name.description: Name of the unencrypted room the bot creates for the allowed user

discord_bot_token.description: Discord bot token; empty keeps the current token

discord_voice_channel_id.description: ID of the Discord voice channel

public_ip.description: Public IP address of this node to advertise for call media; empty for none

use_homeserver_turn.description: Use the TURN server of the bot's homeserver for call media
